title: Field Service Schedule for Home Oxygen Therapy: Maintenance, Response Times and Refill Cycles
content:
# Field Service Schedule — Home Oxygen Therapy

Field service for Home Oxygen Therapy runs on six figures per system class: the calendar months between routine maintenance visits to the stationary unit, the hours within which a reported malfunction is answered with a repair or swap, the hours within which backup oxygen is brought during a reported power outage, the days between scheduled portable cylinder deliveries, the most portable cylinders left on one scheduled delivery, and the days between scheduled liquid reservoir refills.

| System class | Routine maintenance every (calendar months) | Malfunction answered within (hours) | Backup oxygen in a power outage within (hours) | Portable cylinder delivery every (days) | Most cylinders per delivery | Liquid reservoir refill every (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | 6 | 24 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 6 | 24 | 4 | 14 | 12 | 0 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | 6 | 24 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | 6 | 24 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | 6 | 24 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 7 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 3 | 12 | 2 | 14 | 16 | 0 |

## Notes

1. A figure of 0 in the power-outage column means the system needs no power: Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434).
2. A figure of 0 in the cylinder columns means the class has no cylinders; a figure of 0 in the liquid column means the class has no liquid.
3. The classes with scheduled portable cylinder deliveries are Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) and High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431), both every 14 days; the class with scheduled liquid refills is Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434), every 7 days.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical dates)

- For a hypothetical High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) rental, a 3-month maintenance interval from a setup on 10 January places routine visits on 10 April, 10 July and 10 October; a class with a 6-month interval, set up on the same day, places them on 10 July and 10 January.
- A hypothetical malfunction reported at 08:00 is answered by 08:00 the next day for a class with a 24-hour figure, and by 20:00 the same day for the class with a 12-hour figure.
